printed_catalogue_original_source.description: Exploratory printed catalogue retained for comparison; its estimates are not treated as validated classifications.

affine_tail_criterion.criterion: all 55 adjacent differences T(n+3)-T(n) are exactly equal; report the exact rational slope and intercept
affine_tail_criterion.interpretation: Neither label establishes linear or superlinear asymptotic growth.

affine_periodic_analysis.purpose: Exact finite-data affine-plus-periodic model checks; no asymptotic classification
affine_periodic_analysis.selection: Select the smallest period fitting all training observations exactly, using rational arithmetic; validate that fixed model without selecting another period after seeing validation outcomes.
affine_periodic_analysis.validation_requirement: Every withheld observation must match exactly.
affine_periodic_analysis.earlier_sizes: After validation, report the earliest exact suffix of the full saved size list for the same fixed coefficients; do not refit using earlier observations.
